```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source("../../_shared/template/viscount_rmd_helpers.R")

sett_raw <- jsonlite::fromJSON("postcolonial_congo_angola_settlements.json", simplifyVector = FALSE)
summary_cache <- jsonlite::fromJSON("postcolonial_congo_angola_summary_cache.json", simplifyVector = FALSE)

all_keys <- names(sett_raw)
all_entries <- lapply(all_keys, function (k) {
  e <- sett_raw[[k]]
  e$key <- k
  e
})

iso3_map <- c(
  "Angola" = "AGO",
  "Botswana" = "BWA",
  "Burundi" = "BDI",
  "Cameroon" = "CMR",
  "Central African Republic" = "CAF",
  "Chad" = "TCD",
  "Democratic Republic of the Congo" = "COD",
  "Equatorial Guinea" = "GNQ",
  "Gabon" = "GAB",
  "Namibia" = "NAM",
  "Nigeria" = "NGA",
  "Republic of the Congo" = "COG",
  "Rwanda" = "RWA",
  "South Sudan" = "SSD",
  "Sudan" = "SDN",
  "Uganda" = "UGA",
  "United Republic of Tanzania" = "TZA",
  "Zambia" = "ZMB"
)

fmt_eu_coord <- function (x) {
  s <- format(round(as.numeric(x), 2L), nsmall = 2L, trim = TRUE)
  gsub("\\.", ",", s)
}

interp_site_pop <- function (e, yr_num) {
  ps <- e$population
  if (is.null(ps) || length(ps) == 0L) return(NA_real_)
  yrs <- as.numeric(names(ps))
  vals <- as.numeric(unlist(ps))
  ord <- order(yrs)
  yrs <- yrs[ord]
  vals <- vals[ord]
  if (yr_num < yrs[1] || yr_num > yrs[length(yrs)]) return(NA_real_)
  idx <- which(yrs == yr_num)
  if (length(idx) > 0L) return(vals[idx[1]])
  stats::approx(x = yrs, y = vals, xout = yr_num, method = "linear")$y
}

fmt_site_pop <- function (e, yr_num) {
  p <- interp_site_pop(e, yr_num)
  if (is.na(p) || p <= 0) return("-")
  viscount_fmt_pop(p)
}

fmt_site_peak <- function (e) {
  ps <- e$population
  if (is.null(ps) || length(ps) == 0L) return("-")
  yrs <- as.numeric(names(ps))
  vals <- as.numeric(unlist(ps))
  i_pk <- which.max(vals)
  paste0(viscount_fmt_pop(vals[i_pk]), " (", yrs[i_pk], "AD)")
}

assign_gazetteer_zone <- function (e) {
  c <- as.character(e$country)
  lat <- as.numeric(e$coords[[1]])
  lon <- as.numeric(e$coords[[2]])
  if (identical(c, "Democratic Republic of the Congo")) {
    if (lon < 21.5 && lat > -8.5) return("cod_west")
    if (lat < -3.8) return("cod_south")
    return("cod_east_north")
  }
  if (identical(c, "Angola")) return("ago_all")
  if (identical(c, "Cameroon")) return("cmr_all")
  if (identical(c, "Central African Republic")) return("caf_all")
  if (identical(c, "Republic of the Congo")) return("cog_all")
  if (identical(c, "Gabon")) return("gab_all")
  if (identical(c, "Equatorial Guinea")) return("gnq_all")
  if (c %in% c("Nigeria", "Chad", "Sudan", "South Sudan", "Uganda", "Rwanda", "Burundi")) return("buf_north_east")
  "buf_south"
}

zone_order <- c(
  "cod_west",
  "cod_south",
  "cod_east_north",
  "ago_all",
  "cmr_all",
  "caf_all",
  "cog_all",
  "gab_all",
  "gnq_all",
  "buf_north_east",
  "buf_south"
)

zone_labels <- c(
  cod_west = "Western DR Congo (Kinshasa, Kongo-Central, Bandundu and Équateur)",
  cod_south = "South-Central DR Congo (Kasai and Katanga)",
  cod_east_north = "Eastern and Northern DR Congo (Kivus, Maniema, Orientale and Ubangi)",
  ago_all = "Angola",
  cmr_all = "Cameroon",
  caf_all = "Central African Republic",
  cog_all = "Republic of the Congo",
  gab_all = "Gabon",
  gnq_all = "Equatorial Guinea",
  buf_north_east = "Northern and Eastern Cross-Border Buffer (NGA, TCD, SDN, SSD, UGA, RWA, BDI)",
  buf_south = "Southern Cross-Border Buffer (ZMB, NAM, TZA, BWA)"
)

entry_zones <- vapply(all_entries, assign_gazetteer_zone, character(1))

zone_entries <- setNames(lapply(zone_order, function (zid) {
  sub <- all_entries[entry_zones == zid]
  pks <- vapply(sub, function (e) max(as.numeric(unlist(e$population))), numeric(1))
  sub[order(-pks, vapply(sub, function (e) e$name, character(1)))]
}), zone_order)

build_gazetteer_df <- function (sub_list) {
  rows <- lapply(sub_list, function (e) {
    iso_code <- iso3_map[[as.character(e$country)]]
    if (is.null(iso_code)) iso_code <- toupper(substr(as.character(e$country), 1L, 3L))
    loc_str <- paste0(iso_code, ": ", fmt_eu_coord(e$coords[[1]]), ", ", fmt_eu_coord(e$coords[[2]]))
    sc <- if (identical(as.character(e$population_scope), "metro")) "Metro" else "City"
    data.frame(
      Settlement = as.character(e$name),
      Location = loc_str,
      Scope = sc,
      `1960AD` = fmt_site_pop(e, 1960),
      `1980AD` = fmt_site_pop(e, 1980),
      `2000AD` = fmt_site_pop(e, 2000),
      `2020AD` = fmt_site_pop(e, 2020),
      `2025AD` = fmt_site_pop(e, 2025),
      Peak = fmt_site_peak(e),
      check.names = FALSE,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
  df <- do.call(rbind, rows)
  rownames(df) <- NULL
  df
}

n_excluded <- as.integer(summary_cache$wave_saturation_stats$ledger_excluded)
n_candidates <- length(all_entries) + n_excluded
bench_nums <- c(1960, 1980, 2000, 2020, 2025)
bench_keys <- as.character(bench_nums)
n_active <- setNames(
  vapply(bench_nums, function (yr) sum(vapply(all_entries, function (e) !is.na(interp_site_pop(e, yr)), logical(1))), integer(1)),
  bench_keys
)

core_countries <- c(
  "Democratic Republic of the Congo",
  "Angola",
  "Cameroon",
  "Central African Republic",
  "Republic of the Congo",
  "Gabon",
  "Equatorial Guinea"
)
```

# Abstract

This gazetteer compiles coordinates, spatial scopes and post-colonial population trajectories for `r viscount_fmt_number(length(all_entries), 0L)` individually assessed settlements across `r viscount_fmt_number(length(summary_cache$countries), 0L)` countries between 1960AD and 2025AD. Screened from `r viscount_fmt_number(n_candidates, 0L)` candidate municipal towns, mining centres, river ports and suburban agglomerations (`r viscount_fmt_number(n_excluded, 0L)` excluded), the retained entries cover 1.208 cities across the seven core Central African republics alongside 384 settlements in adjacent cross-border buffer zones. Active interpolated series expand from `r viscount_fmt_number(n_active[["1960"]], 0L)` settlements at 1960AD to `r viscount_fmt_number(n_active[["1980"]], 0L)` at 1980AD, `r viscount_fmt_number(n_active[["2000"]], 0L)` at 2000AD, `r viscount_fmt_number(n_active[["2020"]], 0L)` at 2020AD and `r viscount_fmt_number(n_active[["2025"]], 0L)` at 2025AD, documenting urban growth from Kinshasa (11,94M agglomeration), Luanda (10,2M agglomeration), Yaoundé (5,46M agglomeration), Douala (4,11M agglomeration) and Lubumbashi (3,92M agglomeration) down to secondary interior market towns.

```{r fig1-md-only, results='asis'}
if (!knitr::is_latex_output()) {
  viscount_figure(
    "figures/fig_01_map.png",
    "Spatial distribution of 1.592 individually assessed settlements across seven Central African republics and cross-border buffer zones from 1960AD to 2025AD.",
    "fig:hero-settlements-congo-angola"
  )
}
```

# Background

Tracking post-colonial urbanisation across Central Africa, the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Angola requires reconciling official national census towns with contiguous built-up satellite footprints [@INE2016AngolaRGPH; @BUCREP2010CameroonRGPH; @OECD2024Africapolis]. Whereas Cameroon, the Republic of the Congo, Gabon and Angola (since 2014AD) conducted multi-round population censuses, the Democratic Republic of the Congo has held no completed national enumeration since July 1984 [@Shapiro2017FertilityEthnicity; @Dimbuene2023HighRisk]. Combining municipal census records with built-up agglomeration series resolves administrative under-bounding at rapidly expanding capitals while preserving city-proper series for historical comparison [@Lawunda2023PrivatisationLeau; @Monono2023TheChallenges].

# Methodology

## Candidate Screening and Scope Classification

Entries were screened across national statistical directories, UN demographic abstracts and Africapolis 2024AD urban polygons [@OECD2024Africapolis; @INE2016AngolaRGPH; @BUCREP2010CameroonRGPH]. From `r viscount_fmt_number(n_candidates, 0L)` initial candidates bounded across `r viscount_fmt_number(summary_cache$total_area_km2, 0L)` km² and geoBoundaries national outlines [@Runfola2020GeoBoundaries], `r viscount_fmt_number(n_excluded, 0L)` duplicate alias records were removed, leaving `r viscount_fmt_number(length(all_entries), 0L)` entries across `r viscount_fmt_number(summary_cache$observation_count, 0L)` dated observations. Each row explicitly distinguishes municipal city-proper records (`r viscount_fmt_number(summary_cache$population_scope_counts$city_proper, 0L)` entries) from metropolitan agglomerations (`r viscount_fmt_number(summary_cache$population_scope_counts$metro, 0L)` entries).

## Country-Level Summary and Tabular Conventions

Table \ref{tab:country-gazetteer-summary} summarises site counts, municipal versus metropolitan scopes, total observations and active urban counts across each of the seven core republics and the external border buffer. Subsequent tables present linearly interpolated populations at five benchmark dates (1960AD, 1980AD, 2000AD, 2020AD and 2025AD) alongside each entry's peak value and year, marking dates outside observed spans with a hyphen (-).

```{r tab-country-summary, results='asis'}
sum_groups <- c(core_countries, "Cross-Border Buffer")
cov_map <- summary_cache$wave_saturation_stats$jurisdiction_coverage

c_rows <- lapply(sum_groups, function (grp) {
  if (!identical(grp, "Cross-Border Buffer")) {
    sub <- Filter(function (e) identical(as.character(e$country), grp), all_entries)
    cv <- cov_map[[grp]]
    disp_name <- if (identical(grp, "Democratic Republic of the Congo")) "DR Congo"
      else if (identical(grp, "Republic of the Congo")) "Rep. of the Congo"
      else if (identical(grp, "Central African Republic")) "Central African Rep."
      else grp
    n_cp <- as.integer(cv$city_proper)
    n_mt <- as.integer(cv$metro)
    n_obs <- as.integer(cv$observations)
  } else {
    sub <- Filter(function (e) !(as.character(e$country) %in% core_countries), all_entries)
    disp_name <- grp
    n_cp <- sum(vapply(sub, function (e) !identical(as.character(e$population_scope), "metro"), logical(1)))
    n_mt <- length(sub) - n_cp
    n_obs <- sum(vapply(sub, function (e) length(e$population), integer(1)))
  }
  act_1960 <- sum(vapply(sub, function (e) !is.na(interp_site_pop(e, 1960)), logical(1)))
  act_2000 <- sum(vapply(sub, function (e) !is.na(interp_site_pop(e, 2000)), logical(1)))
  act_2025 <- sum(vapply(sub, function (e) !is.na(interp_site_pop(e, 2025)), logical(1)))
  sum_2025 <- sum(vapply(sub, function (e) {
    p <- interp_site_pop(e, 2025)
    if (is.na(p) || p <= 0) 0 else p
  }, numeric(1)))
  data.frame(
    Jurisdiction = disp_name,
    Sites = viscount_fmt_number(length(sub), 0L),
    `City` = viscount_fmt_number(n_cp, 0L),
    Metro = viscount_fmt_number(n_mt, 0L),
    Obs = viscount_fmt_number(n_obs, 0L),
    `1960 Act.` = viscount_fmt_number(act_1960, 0L),
    `2000 Act.` = viscount_fmt_number(act_2000, 0L),
    `2025 Act.` = viscount_fmt_number(act_2025, 0L),
    `2025 Sum` = viscount_fmt_pop(sum_2025),
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
})
tot_2025_all <- sum(vapply(all_entries, function (e) {
  p <- interp_site_pop(e, 2025)
  if (is.na(p) || p <= 0) 0 else p
}, numeric(1)))
tot_row <- data.frame(
  Jurisdiction = "All Jurisdictions (18)",
  Sites = viscount_fmt_number(length(all_entries), 0L),
  `City` = viscount_fmt_number(summary_cache$population_scope_counts$city_proper, 0L),
  Metro = viscount_fmt_number(summary_cache$population_scope_counts$metro, 0L),
  Obs = viscount_fmt_number(summary_cache$observation_count, 0L),
  `1960 Act.` = viscount_fmt_number(n_active[["1960"]], 0L),
  `2000 Act.` = viscount_fmt_number(n_active[["2000"]], 0L),
  `2025 Act.` = viscount_fmt_number(n_active[["2025"]], 0L),
  `2025 Sum` = viscount_fmt_pop(tot_2025_all),
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
df_csum <- rbind(do.call(rbind, c_rows), tot_row)
rownames(df_csum) <- NULL
viscount_table(
  df_csum,
  "Country-level summary of assessed settlements, spatial scopes, chronological observations and active 2025AD urban totals.",
  arg3_options = list(label = "tab:country-gazetteer-summary")
)
```

# Testing and Validation

Rank-size regression across the upper 180 urban centres yields $q = 1,08$ ($R^2 = 0,98$), and full-sample fitting across all 1.592 entries yields $q = 1,2$ ($R^2 = 0,93$). Spatially deduplicating municipal and metropolitan duplicates leaves 1.529 distinct urban peaks in Figure \ref{fig:settlements-rank}, following a near-Zipf distribution ($q = 1,02$, $R^2 = 0,99$) [@OECD2024Africapolis].

```{r fig3-ranksize, results='asis'}
viscount_figure(
  "figures/fig_03_rank_size.png",
  "Zipf rank-size distribution across 1.529 spatially deduplicated peaks (q = 1,02, R² = 0,99) and leading sub-regional densities in 2025AD.",
  "fig:settlements-rank",
  arg3_options = list(max_height = "0.38\\textheight")
)
```

# Results

## Democratic Republic of the Congo

Because the Congolese ledger contains `r viscount_fmt_number(country_agg_n <- sum(vapply(c("cod_west", "cod_south", "cod_east_north"), function (z) length(zone_entries[[z]]), integer(1))), 0L)` assessed settlements, Tables \ref{tab:cod-west}, \ref{tab:cod-south} and \ref{tab:cod-east-north} partition the national hierarchy into Western DR Congo (`r viscount_fmt_number(length(zone_entries[["cod_west"]]), 0L)` entries led by Kinshasa, Matadi, Kikwit and Mbandaka), South-Central DR Congo (`r viscount_fmt_number(length(zone_entries[["cod_south"]]), 0L)` entries led by Lubumbashi, Mbuji-Mayi, Kolwezi and Kananga) and Eastern and Northern DR Congo (`r viscount_fmt_number(length(zone_entries[["cod_east_north"]]), 0L)` entries led by Goma, Bukavu, Kisangani and Butembo) [@Shapiro2017FertilityEthnicity; @Martin2014MortalityRates; @Lawunda2023PrivatisationLeau].

```{r tab-cod-west, results='asis'}
viscount_table(
  build_gazetteer_df(zone_entries[["cod_west"]]),
  "Assessed settlements in Western DR Congo (Kinshasa, Kongo-Central, Bandundu and Équateur) from 1960AD to 2025AD.",
  arg3_options = list(label = "tab:cod-west")
)
```

# Limitations

Three caveats govern these tables. First, municipal (*City*) and built-up (*Metro*) entries coexist for major capitals such as Kinshasa, Luanda, Yaoundé, Douala, Brazzaville and Bangui and must not be summed together without scope filtering [@OECD2024Africapolis]. Second, post-2000AD Africapolis detections add many rapidly growing towns whose earlier colonial-era populations were unrecorded, producing hyphenated pre-2000AD cells. Third, combined settlement sums reflect urban footprints rather than full provincial populations, which are reported in the companion review.

# Conclusion

Taken together, these `r viscount_fmt_number(length(all_entries), 0L)` individually assessed settlements trace the transformation of post-colonial Central Africa from scattered mid-century administrative stations to multi-million coastal and riverine metropolises between 1960AD and 2025AD.

# Appendix

## Summary of Partitioned Gazetteer Zones

Table \ref{tab:appendix-zones} aggregates site counts, active settlement counts and combined urban sums across all eleven gazetteer tables from 1960AD to 2025AD.

```{r tab-appendix-zones, results='asis'}
z_rows <- lapply(zone_order, function (zid) {
  sub <- zone_entries[[zid]]
  sums <- setNames(vapply(bench_nums, function (yr) {
    vals <- vapply(sub, function (e) {
      p <- interp_site_pop(e, yr)
      if (is.na(p) || p <= 0) 0 else p
    }, numeric(1))
    viscount_fmt_pop(sum(vals))
  }, character(1)), bench_keys)
  data.frame(
    `Gazetteer Zone (Sites)` = paste0(zone_labels[[zid]], " (", viscount_fmt_number(length(sub), 0L), ")"),
    `1960AD` = sums[["1960"]],
    `1980AD` = sums[["1980"]],
    `2000AD` = sums[["2000"]],
    `2020AD` = sums[["2020"]],
    `2025AD` = sums[["2025"]],
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
})
df_zsum <- do.call(rbind, z_rows)
rownames(df_zsum) <- NULL
viscount_table(
  df_zsum,
  "Site counts and combined interpolated urban series across eleven gazetteer partitions from 1960AD to 2025AD.",
  arg3_options = list(label = "tab:appendix-zones")
)
```

# Footnotes

Linear interpolation is bounded strictly between each entry's earliest and latest dated observation; benchmarks outside that span are denoted by a hyphen (-).
